messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Higher and further education, Political behaviour and attitudes, and Government, political systems and organisations in Germany during the 1960s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS German election study 1961 1965 1969 dataset ZA
GESIS 1960s Germany university students political attitudes survey dataset
GESIS German general election 1969 pre post election study dataset
action.query: GESIS German election study 1961 1965 1969 dataset ZA

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Attitudes to College and Politics 1969 (Einstellungen zu Hochschule und Politik 1969)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.0363","justification":"Highly relevant to all three requested topics. This 1969 survey examines students enrolled at the University of Cologne during the 1967/68 winter semester. It covers higher education conditions, university governance, student political participation, student protests, political organizations, attitudes toward parliamentary democracy, and political party preferences. It also explores attitudes toward government policies, university autonomy, student representation, and the West German political system. Particularly valuable for studying the relationship between higher education and political activism during the German student movement of the late 1960s."},{"title":"Issue Dimensions and Voting Decision (April 1969)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.0395","justification":"A West German political attitudes survey conducted between April and May 1969. It investigates voting intentions, political party preferences, evaluations of government performance, and attitudes toward major political controversies. Particularly relevant are questions concerning education policy, social policy, political radicalism, recognition of East Germany, and the perceived competence of political parties. The dataset supports research on political behavior, government institutions, and the importance of educational issues in electoral politics."},{"title":"German Pre- and Post-Election Study, 1969","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.3886/ICPSR07098.v1","justification":"A comprehensive survey conducted before and after the 1969 West German federal election. It includes information about political participation, voter attitudes, party identification, political knowledge, government evaluations, and perceptions of political leaders. The study also examines public attitudes toward domestic policy issues and the ability of political parties to address national problems. Respondent characteristics permit investigation of relationships between educational background and political behavior. Particularly useful for examining democratic participation and electoral politics in West Germany at the end of the 1960s."},{"title":"Resonance of the Population to the Election Campaign and the Result of the Federal Parliament Election 1969","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.0789","justification":"A survey examining West German public reactions to the 1969 federal election campaign and its results. Topics include political interest, participation in election meetings, assessments of political parties and politicians, satisfaction with election outcomes, and preferences regarding government coalitions. It provides evidence about public perceptions of democratic institutions, political competition, and government formation. Relevant to political behavior and attitudes as well as government, political systems, and organizations during the 1960s."},{"title":"Cologne Election Study (Federal Republic, November 1961)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0057","justification":"Part of a three-wave election research project associated with the 1961 West German federal election. This wave was conducted after the formation of the new government, making it particularly useful for examining political attitudes in the context of electoral competition and government formation. The study provides historical survey evidence relevant to political behavior, democratic institutions, and the political system of the Federal Republic of Germany during the early 1960s."},{"title":"German Federal Election Studies, 1949–2005","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/elections/german-federal-elections","justification":"A collection of historical German election survey datasets maintained by GESIS, including studies associated with the 1961, 1965, and 1969 federal elections. The collection includes cross-sectional surveys, panel studies, and cumulative datasets examining political preferences, electoral behavior, and attitudes toward political parties and government. The 1960s studies are especially relevant for investigating changes in political participation, democratic attitudes, and political institutions across the decade. Individual studies can be located through the linked GESIS data catalog."},{"title":"German State Election Studies, 1962–2004","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/elections/german-state-elections","justification":"A GESIS collection of representative surveys conducted in connection with elections in German federal states, beginning in 1962. The collection includes an integrated dataset covering 1962–2004, allowing researchers to investigate regional electoral behavior and political attitudes over time. The observations from the 1960s are particularly relevant for studying political participation, regional government, political parties, and the relationship between state-level and federal politics in West Germany. Researchers can select the relevant years to focus specifically on the 1960s."}]}
